title: Separating Genetic and Protein Evidence in Open Targets: An Auditable Re-ranking Study
abstract: arXiv:2611.29978v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Biomedical target-ranking platforms combine genetics, literature, experimental evidence, tractability, and clinical precedent because each is useful for target discovery. A single integrated score, however, can be awkward to reuse for a narrower question such as which genes have direct evidence for disease risk or etiology. We examine this issue in Open Targets associations for Alzheimer disease (AD) and Parkinson disease (PD). Genetics-linked evidence and protein-oriented evidence are scored in separate channels and combined only at the end. In AD, the Open Targets overall top 20 contains 7 curated genetics-supported genes and 10 symptomatic pharmacology controls; the default late fusion contains 15 curated genes and no symptomatic controls. In PD, late fusion retains 13 curated genes and removes the 5 symptomatic controls present in the platform top 20. A genetics-only ranking reaches similar curated recall (14 genes in AD, 13 in PD)

translated_title: 在Open Targets中分离遗传学与蛋白质证据：一项可审计的重排序研究
translated_abstract: 生物医学靶点排序平台整合了遗传学、文献、实验证据、可成药性和临床先例，因为每一项证据都对靶点发现有用。然而，单一的整合分数在用于更狭窄的问题时可能不便复用，例如判断哪些基因具有疾病风险或病因的直接证据。我们在Open Targets针对阿尔茨海默病（AD）和帕金森病（PD）的关联数据中考察了这一问题。遗传学相关证据与蛋白质导向证据在各自独立的通道中评分，仅在最终阶段进行合并。在AD中，Open Targets总排名前20包含7个经人工策展的遗传学支持基因和10个症状性药理学对照；默认的后期融合方法包含15个策展基因且不含症状性对照。在PD中，后期融合保留了13个策展基因，并移除了平台前20中存在的5个症状性对照。仅基于遗传学的排序达到了相近的策展基因召回率（AD中14个基因，PD中13个基因）。
tldr: 本研究将Open Targets中的遗传学证据与蛋白质证据分离评分并重新排序，结果显示仅使用遗传学证据即可在阿尔茨海默病和帕金森病中达到与默认综合评分相近的策展基因召回率，同时去除症状性药理学对照，使靶点优先级评估更加透明可审计。
en_tdlr: This study separates genetic and protein evidence channels in Open Targets and re-ranks targets, showing that a genetics-only ranking achieves curated gene recall similar to the default integrated score for Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease while removing symptomatic pharmacology controls, making target prioritization more auditable.
